evidence: The weighting test is conclusive: binary IDF beats evidence- and confidence-weighted variants, and every filter loses signal.
observation: An edge-selection experiment compared cosine scores from an IDF-SVD of the training target-disease matrix under different filters and weightings. Every restriction (curated sources only, evidence count at least 2 or 3, scored rows only) and every confidence-based weighting lost signal, so the authoring rule became keep all associations and use binary IDF.
subject: F-60
title: Keeping every association with binary IDF beats every evidence filter
